name: OSFI B-13 (Technology & Cyber Risk)
description: OSFI Guideline B-13 — Technology and Cyber Risk Management expectations for federally regulated financial institutions, structured around governance, technology operations & resilience, and cyber security.
authority: Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI), Canada
scope: Federally regulated financial institutions (banks, insurers, trust and loan companies) in Canada

families.name: Governance & Risk Management
families.description: Accountability, strategy, and risk management for technology and cyber

controls.name: Technology & Cyber Governance
controls.description: Establish clear accountability, a board-approved technology and cyber risk strategy, and defined roles for senior management oversight.

controls.name: Technology & Cyber Risk Management Framework
controls.description: Maintain a risk management framework (RMF) with risk appetite, taxonomy, identification, assessment, and reporting for technology and cyber risks.

controls.name: Third-Party Technology Risk
controls.description: Assess and manage risks from third-party technology and cloud service providers, including concentration and subcontractor risk, aligned with Guideline B-10.

families.name: Technology Operations & Resilience
families.description: Asset management, change, and operational resilience

controls.name: Technology Asset Management
controls.description: Maintain a current inventory of technology assets, mapped to business services, with defined ownership and lifecycle management.

controls.name: Change & Release Management
controls.description: Manage technology changes through a controlled process with testing, approval, and rollback to avoid disruption to critical operations.

controls.name: Disaster Recovery & Resilience
controls.description: Establish recovery objectives (RTO/RPO), tested backups, and disaster recovery for critical systems to meet operational resilience expectations.

controls.name: Technology Operations Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the technology environment for availability, capacity, and performance of systems supporting critical business services.

families.name: Cyber Security
families.description: Cyber defence, identity, and incident response

controls.name: Cyber Defence & Secure Configuration
controls.description: Implement layered cyber defences: secure baseline configurations, vulnerability and patch management, and network segmentation.

controls.name: Identity & Access Management
controls.description: Enforce strong authentication (including MFA), least privilege, and privileged access management across systems.

controls.name: Cyber Incident & OSFI Reporting
controls.description: Detect, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents, and report technology/cyber incidents to OSFI within the required timeframe.

controls.name: Data Security & Cryptography
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of data through encryption in transit and at rest and sound key management.
